findings.title: Approved remediation bytes can be substituted after review
findings.reproduction: After a complete candidate, adverse R01, remediation, and approved R02 sequence, a later commit changed only remediation.resolution before UI. The gate checked projection fields but not exact adopted-record bytes and returned ok true.
findings.requiredResolution: Construct each review projection from the exact reviewed record with only canonical status, attempt, and review changes; require final adopted bytes to equal the final review-introduction bytes; and add a post-approval substitution regression.
